options.description: Suppresses 'Follow your friends' modals, 'Find contacts' Friends tab sync overlays, multi-account notification guides, and 'Security checkup 2SV' upsells.

options.description: Suppresses repetitive PopLayer prompts including favorites collection guides, launcher shortcut dialogs, repost newbie sheets, STEM feed prompts, campus education sheets, creator inbox guides, app review dialogs, marketing opt-ins, FYP surveys, CapCut/Lemon8 upsells, profile visitor prompts, and story intro sheets.

options.description: Disables floating live stream preview teasers and popup windows from appearing over the video feed.

options.description: Suppresses direct message streak expiration warning banners and inline urgency reminders.

patches.description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads) and prevents aggressive video buffer preloading to conserve battery and CPU resources.

patches.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.

patches.description: Strips embedded onboarding MP4 tutorial video, heavy IMG.LY photo editor stickers/textures, and compiler junk metadata.

patches.description: Remembers playback timestamp when scrolling away and resumes from where playback stopped upon returning.

patches.description: Displays the creator's country or region code next to their username in video author info across feeds and deep-linked detail views.

options.description: 5-6 digit MCC+MNC code (e.g. '22801' for Switzerland/Swisscom) used to spoof TelephonyManager operator queries and CellIdentity MCC/MNC reads. Empty keeps stock operator values.

options.description: Display name reported for SIM/network operator queries (e.g. 'Swisscom'). Empty keeps the stock operator name.
options.title: Spoofed Operator Name

patches.description: Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.

patches.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches.description: Bypasses the entire first-run introduction funnel (interest pickers, swipe tutorials, language prompts, and consent sheets) directly to the feed.
patches.name: Skip First-Launch Onboarding

patches.description: Suppresses the first-launch About/privacy dialog by applying the app's own accept action silently. The About entry in the menu keeps working.
patches.name: Skip Welcome Dialog

patches.description: Unblocks Spatial Audio, hearing enhancement, and voice wake-up restrictions, unbans Spatial Audio on 96kHz aptX Adaptive connections, and bypasses XPAN requirements.
patches.name: Sound Features Unlock

patches.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them in an infinite loop.
patches.name: Stop Video Looping

patches.description: Selectively revokes sensitive hardware, privacy, and system permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Revokes RECORD_AUDIO permission from AndroidManifest.xml (disables voice dictation).

options.description: Revokes system personal dictionary sync permissions (READ_USER_DICTIONARY, WRITE_USER_DICTIONARY) from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Revokes INTERACT_ACROSS_PROFILES permission from AndroidManifest.xml to isolate work and personal profiles.

patches.description: Suppresses intrusive in-app rating surveys, Play Store review prompts, and marketing promo popups (YouTube promo, ad-free callouts, and Brave Ads onboarding).

patches.description: Bypasses Xiaomi OEM gating to enable full feature parity (voice assistant & spatial audio dialogs) on non-Xiaomi devices (Samsung, Pixel, etc.).
patches.name: Surgical OEM Unlock

patches.description: Forces TikTok to use the Android system font instead of bundled proprietary TikTokSans fonts.
patches.name: System Font

patches.description: When closing the active tab in a tab group, selects the previous tab in the same group instead of jumping outside the group.
patches.name: Tab Group Close Selection

patches.description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, hardware, and tracking permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.
patches.name: TikTok Privacy Permissions Stripper

options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+). Notification channels cannot dispatch push alerts.
options.title: Strip Notification Permission

options.description: Remove CAMERA permission. WARNING: Breaks camera recording, photo capturing, QR scanning, LIVE broadcasting, and video creation.
options.title: Strip Camera Permission

options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA permissions. WARNING: Breaks video voice recording, LIVE audio broadcasting, audio comments, and voice/video calling.
options.title: Strip Microphone Permissions

options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION). WARNING: Breaks local gallery picker, drafts, and video/photo saving.
options.title: Strip Storage & Media Permissions

options.description: Remove BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, and BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE permissions. WARNING: Breaks Bluetooth audio accessories, wireless headphones low-latency sync, Cast devices, and external remote controls.
options.title: Strip Bluetooth Permissions

options.description: Remove NFC permission. WARNING: Disables NFC tag interactions and NFC-based hardware authentication tokens.
options.title: Strip NFC Permission

options.description: Remove USE_BIOMETRIC and USE_FINGERPRINT permissions. WARNING: Breaks fingerprint/face biometric unlocking, passkeys, and biometric payment authorization.
options.title: Strip Biometric Permissions

options.description: Remove generic FOREGROUND_SERVICE and specialized types (DATA_SYNC, MEDIA_PLAYBACK, MEDIA_PROJECTION, PHONE_CALL). WARNING: HIGH RISK. Breaks background video uploads, offline caching, media playback notification services, screen sharing, and VoIP calls in background.
options.title: Strip Foreground Service Permissions

options.description: Remove SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission. WARNING: Breaks Picture-in-Picture overlay window outside the app, floating mini-player, and overlay notification heads.
options.title: Strip System Alert Window Permission

options.description: Remove WAKE_LOCK permission. WARNING: Device CPU may sleep during media playback or long video uploads/downloads when screen turns off, suspending progress.
options.title: Strip Wake Lock Permission

options.description: Remove DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE and DETECT_SCREEN_RECORDING permissions to neutralize system-level capture callbacks.
options.title: Strip Screenshot & Recording Detection Permissions

options.description: Remove VIBRATE, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, MANAGE_OWN_CALLS, REORDER_TASKS, SET_WALLPAPER, and USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT permissions. WARNING: Disables haptic feedback vibration, volume adjustments, alarm priority intents, and live wallpaper export.
options.title: Strip Miscellaneous Hardware & System Permissions

options.description: Remove OEM attribution, launcher badges, AICore bindings, and proprietary TikTok internal IPC permissions. WARNING: Removing DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION may impact runtime dynamic broadcast receivers.
options.title: Strip OEM Diagnostic & Background Signals

options.description: Remove Google C2DM/FCM and Amazon ADM push receiver permissions. WARNING: Breaks push notification delivery.
options.title: Strip Push Delivery Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Play in-app billing permission (com.android.vending.BILLING). WARNING: Breaks coin purchases and in-app transactions.
options.title: Strip In-App Billing Permission

patches.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.
patches.name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer

patches.description: Rewrites Dalvik const-string URL/host literals matching a user-supplied hosts blocklist to a sink IP (default 0.0.0.0). The blocklist file is read at patch time, so daily DNS updates apply without patch releases.

options.description: Path to a hosts or plain-domain blocklist file on the patching machine (e.g. Hagezi native.tiktok-onlydomains.txt). Leave empty to skip.
options.title: Hosts blocklist file

options.description: IPv4 address replacing blocked hosts inside const-string literals (e.g. '0.0.0.0').
options.title: Sink IP address

options.description: When enabled, a blocklist entry also matches its subdomains (entry 'example.com' matches 'a.example.com').
options.title: Match subdomains

patches.description: Strips non-essential tracking, crash reporting, and debug companion native libraries in lib/** (e.g. libcrashlytics, libsentry, libbugly, libgwp-asan) by zeroing bytes in-situ.

options.description: Zero native crash reporting and tracking libraries (Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugly, PLCrashReporter).
options.title: Trim Crash Reporting Libraries

options.description: Zero debug memory and profiling libraries (GWP-ASan, Simpleperf, Android Studio profilers).

options.description: Also remove ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permissions. Default is false to prevent SecurityException crashes in apps that query network status without error handling.

options.description: Remove CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permissions.

options.description: Remove Google Cloud Messaging and Firebase Cloud Messaging push receiver permissions (com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE).
options.title: Strip Push Notification Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Services Framework and account sync permissions (com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES, android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS).
options.title: Strip Google Services Sync Permissions

options.description: Enforce android:usesCleartextTraffic='false' on the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.

patches.description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, and hardware permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.
patches.name: Universal Privacy Permissions Stripper

options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Notification Permission

options.description: Remove CAMERA permission from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Camera Permission

options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO and audio capture permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Microphone Permissions

options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE/MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Storage & Media Permissions

options.description: Remove ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, and ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Remove READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, and GET_ACCOUNTS permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

options.description: Remove READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Calendar Permissions

options.description: Remove Bluetooth scanning/connection and nearby Wi-Fi permissions (BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, UWB_RANGING) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Nearby Devices Permissions

options.description: Remove BODY_SENSORS, BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND, and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Body Sensors Permissions

patches.description: Prevents applications from overriding display brightness (such as in-app brightness sliders, barcode/QR full-screen brightness, or window-level overrides) by neutralizing all direct writes to WindowManager.LayoutParams.screenBrightness.

patches.description: Forces the target application to respect system screen timeout and sleep timers by neutralizing keepScreenOn view calls and stripping FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON from windows and layout parameters.
patches.name: Universal Screen Timeout Enforcer

patches.description: Neutralizes FLAG_SECURE on windows, layout params, and SurfaceViews, unlocks audio playback capture, and suppresses Android 14+ screenshot and screen recording detection callbacks.

patches.description: Neutralizes third-party APM, crash reporting, analytics, attribution, session replay, location tracking, and push engagement SDK init and event methods at DEX level via early return-void; companion runtime layer to Universal Telemetry Neutralizer (manifest layer).
patches.name: Universal SDK Blocker

options.description: Neutralize New Relic, Datadog, and Dynatrace monitoring, metric reporting, and HTTP transaction tracing methods.
options.title: Block APM & Performance Monitoring SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Raygun, Shake, Embrace, Splunk Mint, App Center, OpenTelemetry, ACRA, Sentry, Bugsnag, Crashlytics (legacy and Firebase), Fabric, Instabug, Countly, and HockeyApp crash reporters.
options.title: Block Crash Reporting SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Firebase Analytics, Matomo, Leanplum, Localytics, WebEngage, PostHog, MoEngage, Snowplow, mParticle, Treasure Data, Huawei Analytics, Yandex Metrica, Facebook AppEvents, and Sensors Analytics event tracking, capture, and session logging methods.

options.description: Neutralize pre-Firebase Google Analytics tracking, hit dispatching, and activity reporting methods (com.google.analytics and com.google.android.gms.analytics).

options.description: Neutralize UXCam, Smartlook, FullStory, Contentsquare, and Bugsee screen and session recording SDK methods.
options.title: Block Session Replay SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Radar, Gimbal, and Estimote beacon and location tracking SDKs; note OS location permission controls remain the primary gate.

patches.description: Strips advertising and Privacy Sandbox permissions, disables analytics ContentProviders and telemetry background services (Firebase, Sentry, Adjust, AppsFlyer, DataTransport), prunes ComponentDiscovery registrars, and injects telemetry opt-out metadata. Includes an optional toggle to disable push notification services.
patches.name: Universal Telemetry Neutralizer

options.description: Remove AD_ID, Privacy Sandbox attribution/topics/audiences, and Play Install Referrer permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Revoke Advertising & Tracking Permissions

options.description: Disable analytics ContentProviders (Google Measurement, Sentry, Facebook, Flurry, Branch, AppsFlyer).
options.title: Disable Telemetry ContentProviders

options.description: Disable Google Measurement, Google DataTransport, Firebase Sessions, and AppsFlyer background job services.
options.title: Disable Telemetry Background Services

options.description: Disable install referrer and analytics measurement broadcast receivers (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Google Measurement).
options.title: Disable Telemetry Receivers

options.description: Inject meta-data opt-out entries into application tag (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, AppsFlyer, Sentry, Facebook SDK) and prune Firebase discovery registrars.
options.title: Inject Telemetry Opt-Out Flags & Prune Registrars

options.description: Disable com.google.firebase.provider.FirebaseInitProvider. Default is false to prevent issues in apps that depend on Firebase Auth or push notifications.

options.description: Disable Meta Fbns, PushLite, and Firebase Cloud Messaging services plus push receivers (Firebase IID, Braze). WARNING: this breaks push notifications; enable only to fully silence background push delivery.
options.title: Disable Push Notification Services

options.description: Disable legacy Google Analytics background services and receivers (distinct from Firebase AppMeasurement, which is covered by the telemetry toggles above).
options.title: Disable Google Analytics Services

options.description: Disable Meta Analytics2/OneFabric upload services, Instagram upload scheduler receiver, and deferred analytics worker components.
options.title: Disable Meta Analytics Upload Pipeline

options.description: Disable Lacrima lock-screen/shutdown crash detectors, crash-loop state trackers, and background crash-dump upload services. User-initiated bug reports are untouched.

options.description: Disable attribution, FDID/PhoneId/USDiD, and FamilyApps cross-app identity providers plus referrer and cross-signing components. WARNING: may break login, account switching, and deferred deep links; enable only to fully silence device-identity collection.
options.title: Disable Device-ID & Cross-App Identity Providers

options.description: Disable Google ML Kit InitProvider, ComponentDiscoveryService, and prune related registrars. WARNING: Breaks on-device barcode scanning, face detection, and text recognition.
options.title: Disable ML Kit On-Device Vision

options.description: Remove ad SDK auto-init entries (e.g. Unity Ads) from the androidx.startup InitializationProvider. WARNING: may break rewarded ads and ad-gated features; enable only to block SDK auto-initialization.

patches.description: Losslessly strips non-rendering metadata and ancillary chunks (EXIF, XMP, ICCP) from WebP assets across res/ and assets/ to reduce APK size.

options.description: Remove camera parameters, geolocation, and creator metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip EXIF Metadata

options.description: Remove Adobe XMP XML metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip XMP Metadata

options.description: Remove ICCP color profile chunks. Default is false to preserve color profile fidelity on wide-gamut displays.
options.title: Strip ICC Color Profiles

patches.description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters and suppressing grace period payment warnings in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).
patches.name: Unlock Pro

patches.description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.
patches.name: Update Prompt Suppressor

options.description: Aspect ratio mode for feed and story videos: 'fit' (entire video visible without crop), or 'fill' (crop to fill screen).
options.title: Video Fit Mode

patches.description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).
patches.name: Video Quality Governor

options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution

options.description: Drops ByteVC2 renditions from playback bitrate lists when an H.264 or ByteVC1 alternative exists, so videos use the hardware decoder instead of TikTok's CPU-bound ByteVC2 software decoder.
options.title: Avoid ByteVC2 Software Decoding

options.description: When the ladder's lowest video stream exceeds the device hardware decoder capability (queried via MediaCodecList), drops video streams and keeps audio-only instead of entering decoder-reject retry loops that freeze the device.
options.title: Drop Undecodable Video Streams

patches.description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.
